scope: Single RTX5090, ULTRA, BF16 growable context cache, original Q4_K/Q8_0 GGUF. Startup included; all byte-ledger runs are diagnostic for detailed I/O. Board VRAM includes existing display/context usage. RSS is the native producer peak.

runs.label: e4final-r0-n1-49555-k2541
runs.timing_limit: Inspect/admit/allocation startup outlier; do not attribute its total difference solely to the replay setting.

diagnostic.note: Separate instrumented run, not a throughput control. Probe rates use the actual registered carry lease during the real weight stream; overlap is with submitted-to-fenced stage intervals, not a hardware DMA trace.

carry_copy_scope: 64MiB pinned buffers; 2GiB per direction; 4GiB DirectStorage read when enabled. Active DS fences span copy intervals. This synthetic queue is not a raw RAID bandwidth benchmark. Separate GPU-event rates do not prove simultaneous H2D/D2H; inspect wall time as well.
